title: Days to Delivery and the Maternity & Delivery Package Deposit Percentage
content:
For the enrollment deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package under Good Faith & Price Estimates, an enrollment deposit paid close to the expected delivery date carries a higher deposit percentage.

The days to delivery run from today's date to the expected delivery date, today not counted and the delivery date counted. Thirty or fewer days to delivery, a passed expected delivery date included, set the deposit percentage at one hundred percent (100); thirty-one to sixty days set it at fifty percent (50); sixty-one or more days leave the package's deposit percentage as it is. A percentage so set takes the place of the package's deposit percentage and is the package's deposit percentage for the enrollment deposit.

| Days to delivery | Deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| expected delivery date passed, or today | 100 |
| 1 to 30 | 100 |
| 31 to 60 | 50 |
| 61 or more | the package's deposit percentage, unchanged |

Boundary readings (hypothetical): 30 days to delivery, 100; 31 days, 50; 60 days, 50; 61 days, unchanged.
